session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Broad Bear Channel, Bull Breakout Then Sideways into Close' (ET+13 hrs, Feb 4/5, Feb 5 axis; inset Broad Bear Channel daily Th-W). Double top 2 legs up and Low 2 at the 6960 open high, then a broad bear channel staircase with double/triple bottom attempts inside the channel, parabolic wedge sell climax at the 6855 lows (01:40-02:00), a double/triple bottom breakout of the bear channel late (03:15) up to the 6930 resistance (red dotted Low 2 area), and a sideways boxed close 6890-6930.
